propositions: The grounding worker harness hard-codes fork context which triggers CPython 3.12+ DeprecationWarning when a background thread exists, risking deadlock in the child process.
Default process start method must be changed to spawn for cross-platform safety; fork must become opt-in via explicit caller-supplied multiprocessing context.
Worker callables, arguments, and return values must be pickleable and importable at module level under spawn, whereas fork previously accepted unpicklable closures.
Process construction/start/serialization failures and parent receive/unpickling failures must return abstain-mode RunResult rather than propagate exceptions.
All existing grounding lifecycle tests pass under spawn except one fixture with unpicklable local closure, which must be replaced with parent-only proxy.
